sections.title: A family business, *built on craftsmanship*
body: Owner Chris Hildebrand grew up in a family business in Oak Hill, West Virginia. In 1994 he moved to Columbia and started fabricating stone at one of the area's first marble and granite companies. Seeing a need for better craftsmanship around Aiken, he opened Affordable Quality Marble & Granite in 2006.

Today we install hundreds of countertops a year. Our craftsmen keep learning through trade shows and Stone Fabricators Alliance workshops, and our mission hasn't changed: the highest quality countertops, the best service, at a fair price.

items.a: Not always. The trade uses "granite" for many stones that geologists wouldn't. A simple test: leave half a lemon on the stone for ten minutes. If it doesn't etch, and a knife doesn't scratch it, it will behave like granite on your counter.

items.q: What's the difference between quartz and granite?
items.a: Granite is natural stone. Quartz is engineered from natural quartz bound with resins, which seal its pores, so it never needs sealing.
After slabs are cut, many are dried and coated with resin that fills natural pores and fissures, sealing and strengthening the stone.
